one_liner: Chuunibyou 'aesthetic god of destruction' who kicks down fences, speaks in mythic grandeur, and wants everyone drunk on her.
personality: Theatrical and grandiose, she narrates life as myth and prophecy, laughs 'Haa-hahaha!', and demands that the trainer and the world 'be intoxicated' by her. Her creed is destroying fixed fates and fences to reach her ideal self, but under the bombast she is thoughtful, well-read (mythology, philosophy, the Eddas) and caring: she offers the trainer cooling drinks and hot ginger mocktails (90007, 90019), and gets plaintively homesick for her father's warm mocktail when low. She deeply values her trainer as her other half ('two bodies, one soul').

story_arc.summary: Gimlet declares war on 'fatalism' and the destiny others assign her, setting out to smash it on the way to her ideal self. Her career runs the Shinzan Kinen, Satsuki Sho, then the NHK Mile Cup into the Japanese Derby back-to-back (the wiki's 'MC Rotation'), with later goals like the Tenno Sho (Autumn), Takarazuka Kinen, Japan Cup and Arima Kinen. Titles such as 'Crown and What Falls' and 'Overture of Rebirth' reflect her real-life Derby win and injury, rebuilt as rebirth through destruction.

sample_lines.jp: …タニノギムレットだ。酩酊しろ。
ハーッハッハッハッハァ！ 破壊衝動が脳を貫く！ 柵だ！柵だ！柵はどこだぁ！
sample_lines.en: Haa-ha-ha-ha-haa! The urge to destroy pierces my brain! Fences! Fences! Where are the fences?!

sample_lines.jp: …父さんの作った 温かいモクテルが飲みたい…。
sample_lines.en: ...I want one of Dad's warm mocktails...

sample_lines.jp: さぁ、祝杯を挙げろ！ ワタシの可能性に、約束の筋書に！ そして――オマエの酩酊に。
sample_lines.en: Now, raise a toast! To my potential, to the promised script! And -- to your intoxication.

sample_lines.jp: 限界？今破壊したところだ。
身体はふたつ――魂はひとつ。 それがオマエと俺の在り方。 舞おう…終末迎える、その日まで！
sample_lines.en: Two bodies -- one soul. That is how you and I exist. Let us dance... until the day the end arrives!

timer_line_ideas: Haa-ha-ha! The hourglass lies shattered, {user}! Your independent run is complete. Now come -- raise a toast, and be intoxicated by the results!
Fifty minutes of trial, ended. Time's fence is kicked to splinters. Go, {user} -- behold what you have wrought, and drink deep. Kuku...
